html.description: A URL to the full HTML of the response. Expires 24 hours after generation.

position.description: Position of the source in the list

label.description: Label or title of the source

description.description: Description or snippet of the source

citationPills.description: Inline citation pills extracted from the Gemini answer. Each entry is one (pill, source) pair: when a chip cites N sources (Gemini's `+N` analog or section-summary chips), the array contains N entries sharing the same `citationPillId` but with per-source `label`, `url`, and `domain`. Group by `citationPillId` to recover the pill-level structure. `label` is always present on the wire; it can be an empty string when the rail has no title for a source. Omitted from `result` when the answer carries no pills.

label.description: Per-source title from the sources rail (for example `"Quantum computing — Wikipedia"`). Always present on the wire; may be an empty string when the rail has no title for this source — consumers should read `domain` / `url` for source identity in that case.

citationPillId.description: 1-based ordinal shared by all entries from the same chip. Group by `citationPillId` to reconstruct the visible chip; the per-source `label` differs across entries within a chip.

url.description: Direct URL of the cited source.

domain.description: Host extracted from `url`, for grouping and display.

description.description: Source description from the sources rail when Gemini ships one. Omitted when absent.

position.description: 1-based position of this source in the sibling `result.sources` array.

places.description: Place cards returned for lodging and local answers

index.description: Position index of the place in the results

price.description: Nightly price as Gemini displays it

shoppingCards.description: Product cards Gemini shows on shopping answers, in display order. Field names follow AI Mode's `shoppingCards`. Omitted from `result` when the answer carries no product cards.

position.description: 1-indexed rank across the `shoppingCards` array, in display order

productLink.description: Google Shopping URL for the product

price.description: Current price. For a range, `value` is the lowest price. For an installment offer, only `raw` is present

value.description: Numeric price. Absent for an installment offer

currency.description: Currency symbol or code as displayed. Absent for an installment offer

raw.description: Price text as Gemini displays it

oldPrice.description: Price before a discount, same shape as `price`. Absent when there is no discount

currency.description: Currency symbol or code as displayed

raw.description: Price text as Gemini displays it

store.description: Store that sells the product at `price`

storeLink.description: Direct URL of the product on the store's site

storeCount.description: Number of stores that sell the product. Gemini shows "& more" after the store name when it is above 1

shipping.description: Shipping cost as Gemini displays it

deliveryTime.description: Delivery time as Gemini displays it

rating.description: Product rating (0-5). Absent for a product with no reviews

thumbnail.description: Image URL that the card shows

images.description: All product image URLs. The first one is `thumbnail`

rawResponse.description: Raw upstream provider stream captured during the request. Each item is one chunk from the provider's wire protocol (SSE event, batchexecute frame, etc.). Format is provider-specific, undocumented, and may change without notice — use it for debugging or to access data not yet surfaced in the structured fields above.
